population.kidComparison: About 1 out of every 200 people on Earth lives here, spread across the second-largest country in the world.

geography.climate: Varies from temperate in the south to subarctic and arctic in the north, with cold snowy winters across much of the country.

flag.description: Two vertical red bars framing a white square with a red 11-pointed maple leaf in the center.

anthem.title: O Canada
anthem.summary: Adopted in 1980, celebrating the country's vast northern landscape and freedom.

exploration.didYouKnow: Canada has more lakes than the rest of the world's lakes combined—over two million of them!

regionalTraits: Carries a well-worn hockey puck as a lucky charm
Always orders a double-double coffee before boarding a flight
Wears a wool toque even indoors
Knows the tide schedule for the Bay of Fundy by heart

population.kidComparison: The third most populated country on Earth, with over 335 million people across 50 states.

geography.climate: Mostly temperate, but spans tropical weather in Hawaii and Florida to arctic cold in Alaska and arid deserts in the southwest.

flag.description: 13 red and white stripes with a blue rectangle in the top corner holding 50 white stars.

anthem.title: The Star-Spangled Banner
anthem.summary: Written during the War of 1812 after watching a flag survive an overnight bombardment.

exploration.didYouKnow: Yellowstone was the world's very first national park, established in 1872.

regionalTraits: Collects souvenir state quarters in a velvet pouch
Never travels without a vintage baseball cap
Reads road atlases instead of using GPS

population.kidComparison: About 34 million people live here—roughly the same population as California.

geography.climate: Dry desert along the Pacific coast, cool high mountains in the Andes, and hot, rainy tropical rainforest in the Amazon basin.

flag.description: Three vertical bands of red, white, and red.

anthem.title: Himno Nacional del Perú
anthem.summary: Composed in 1821 to celebrate Peru's independence.

exploration.didYouKnow: Potatoes were first domesticated in the Andes Mountains of Peru thousands of years ago—there are over 3,000 varieties there today!

regionalTraits: Wears a brightly patterned woven Andean scarf
Always carries roasted corn snacks in their coat pocket
Speaks fluently about ancient Inca stone masonry

population.kidComparison: Over 215 million people live here—nearly half of all people in South America!

geography.climate: Mostly tropical and warm year-round, with lush rainforests in the north and cooler subtropical weather in the far south.

flag.description: A green background with a large yellow diamond in the center holding a blue globe studded with 27 white stars.

anthem.title: Hino Nacional Brasileiro
anthem.summary: Celebrates Brazil's rivers, forests, and sunny skies.

exploration.didYouKnow: The Amazon River carries more water than the next seven largest rivers in the world combined.

regionalTraits: Humms samba rhythms while waiting in airport lounges
Carries a miniature soccer ball everywhere
Knows the names of dozens of tropical rainforest birds

population.kidComparison: Around 84 million people live here—the largest population of any country in the European Union.

geography.climate: Temperate seasonal climate with cool, cloudy winters and mild, pleasant summers.

flag.description: Three horizontal stripes of black, red, and gold.

anthem.title: Deutschlandlied
anthem.summary: Set to music composed by Joseph Haydn in 1797, focusing on unity, justice, and freedom.

exploration.didYouKnow: Germany has over 20,000 castles—many of which inspired classic fairy tales!

regionalTraits: Checks a mechanical pocket watch to the exact second
Always buys a warm pretzel at train stations
Keeps a notebook filled with neatly drawn train timetables

population.kidComparison: About 68 million people live across England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland.

geography.climate: Mild, rainy maritime climate—weather can change from sunshine to drizzle in a single afternoon.

flag.description: The Union Jack: red and white crosses overlapping on a dark blue background.

anthem.title: God Save the King
anthem.summary: One of the oldest national anthems in the world, dating back to the 1740s.

exploration.didYouKnow: London's Underground, opened in 1863, is the oldest underground passenger railway in the world.

regionalTraits: Never leaves home without a tightly rolled umbrella
Looks right before crossing the street out of habit
Carries loose tea leaves in a small silver tin

population.kidComparison: About 68 million people live in France, the largest country by land area in Western Europe.

geography.climate: Cool winters and mild summers in the north, snowy mountains in the Alps, and warm sunny weather along the Mediterranean coast.

flag.description: Three vertical bands of blue, white, and red.

anthem.title: La Marseillaise
anthem.summary: Written in 1792, known around the world for its energetic, marching melody.

exploration.didYouKnow: The Eiffel Tower actually grows about 15 centimeters (6 inches) taller in the summer because heat makes the iron expand!

regionalTraits: Sketches landmarks in a tiny pocket sketchbook
Can identify dozens of cheeses by smell alone
Always wears a neatly knotted scarf

population.kidComparison: Around 124 million people live across Japan's islands—Tokyo is the world's largest city area.

geography.climate: Varies from cool and snowy in northern Hokkaido to warm and subtropical in southern Okinawa, with four distinct seasons.

flag.description: A white background with a large crimson-red circle representing the sun in the center.

anthem.title: Kimigayo
anthem.summary: Features lyrics from a 1,000-year-old poem wishing for long-lasting peace and harmony.

exploration.didYouKnow: Japan's Shinkansen bullet trains can travel up to 320 km/h (200 mph) and are famous for arriving within seconds of their schedule.

regionalTraits: Folds origami cranes out of old boarding passes
Collects colorful ink stamps from every train station
Carries a high-tech solar-powered calculator

population.kidComparison: Over 1.4 billion people live here—the largest population of any country in the world!

geography.climate: Tropical monsoon climate in the south, warm plains in the center, and snow-capped Himalayan peaks in the far north.

flag.description: Horizontal stripes of saffron orange, white, and green with a 24-spoke navy blue wheel in the center.

anthem.title: Jana Gana Mana
anthem.summary: Written by poet Rabindranath Tagore, celebrating India's diverse regions, rivers, and mountains.

exploration.didYouKnow: The game of chess was invented in India over 1,400 years ago!

regionalTraits: Always carries a pocket chessboard for long flights
Can name every spice in a dish from across the room
Keeps a lucky brass compass in their jacket

population.kidComparison: Around 114 million people live here—almost everyone lives along the green ribbon of the Nile River.

geography.climate: Hot, sunny desert climate with very little rain, cooled along the Mediterranean coast and the Nile valley.

flag.description: Horizontal stripes of red, white, and black with a golden eagle emblem in the center.

anthem.title: Bilady, Bilady, Bilady
anthem.summary: Means 'My Homeland, My Homeland, My Homeland,' celebrating loyalty to Egypt.

exploration.didYouKnow: The Great Pyramid of Giza was the tallest human-made structure on Earth for over 3,800 years!

regionalTraits: Decodes ancient hieroglyph symbols for fun
Always wears sunglasses and a wide-brimmed sun hat
Knows every ship route through the Suez Canal

population.kidComparison: About 55 million people live here, right across the Earth's Equator.

geography.climate: Warm and tropical along the Indian Ocean coast, and cooler with sunny days and crisp nights in the central highlands.

flag.description: Black, red, and green horizontal stripes separated by thin white lines, with a traditional Maasai shield and crossed spears in the center.

anthem.title: Ee Mungu Nguvu Yetu
anthem.summary: Swahili for 'O God of All Creation,' a prayer for peace, unity, and plenty.

exploration.didYouKnow: Nairobi is the only capital city in the world with a full wildlife national park right next to its skyscrapers!

regionalTraits: Carries compact binoculars around their neck at all times
Can sprint like a marathon runner when spotted
Always drinks hot spiced chai tea

population.kidComparison: About 27 million people live across an entire continent—nearly the same size as the continental United States!

geography.climate: Hot dry desert in the central Outback, tropical in the north, and mild temperate seasons along the southern coasts.

flag.description: Dark blue with the Union Jack in the top corner, a large seven-pointed star below it, and the five stars of the Southern Cross.

anthem.title: Advance Australia Fair
anthem.summary: Celebrates Australia's wide lands, golden soil, and surrounding seas.

exploration.didYouKnow: Australia is home to more kangaroos than people—and it is the only place on Earth where the egg-laying platypus lives in the wild!

regionalTraits: Wears a wide cork-brimmed bush hat
Navigates at night using the Southern Cross stars
Always carries a jar of Vegemite in their suitcase
